children: Laser Photonics closed a $7.9 million public offering of 10,500,000 shares and two series of warrants at $0.75 per share.
Closed offering on Sept 14, 2026: 10,500,000 common shares sold at $0.75 per share with accompanying warrants.
Issued Series B-1 and B-2 warrants to purchase up to 10,500,000 shares each, exercise price $0.75 per share.
Gross proceeds approx. $7.9 million before placement agent fees and offering expenses.
Series B-1 warrants expire five years; Series B-2 warrants expire 24 months; warrants exercisable upon issuance.
Company intends to use net proceeds for R&D, acquisitions and working capital; H.C. Wainwright was placement agent.
